title: Present perfect and past 2 (I have done and I did)

cards.text: Untuk waktu yang sudah selesai (yesterday, last week, in 2010, two days ago, when I was a child), pakai past simple, bukan present perfect. Pertanyaan When ...? dan What time ...? juga memakai past simple.

examples.id: Saya melihatnya kemarin. (bukan have seen yesterday)

examples.en: What time did you finish work?

cards.text: Periode yang belum selesai (today, this week, since ...) memakai present perfect. Periode yang sudah selesai memakai past simple.

examples.en: I haven't seen him this week.
examples.id: Minggu ini saya belum bertemu dia.

examples.en: I didn't see him last week.
examples.id: Minggu lalu saya tidak bertemu dia.

cards.text: Bandingkan keadaan yang masih berlanjut dengan yang sudah berakhir.

examples.en: Jack has lived in Bali for seven years.
examples.id: Jack sudah tujuh tahun tinggal di Bali (masih di sana).

examples.en: Jack lived in Bali for seven years.
examples.id: Jack pernah tinggal di Bali selama tujuh tahun (sekarang tidak).

questions.prompt: We ___ Rina at the party last Saturday.
questions.why: last Saturday adalah waktu yang sudah selesai, jadi past simple.

questions.prompt: What time ___ (you / get) home last night?
questions.why: Pertanyaan What time memakai past simple: did + subjek + kata kerja dasar.

questions.prompt: I have finished my work two hours ago.
questions.answer: I finished my work two hours ago.
questions.why: ago menunjuk waktu yang sudah selesai, jadi pakai past simple.

questions.prompt: It ___ rained this week. Everything is very dry.
questions.why: this week belum selesai, jadi present perfect. Semuanya kering, jadi negatif: hasn't.

questions.prompt: Susun pertanyaan: "Apakah kamu tinggal di desa waktu kecil?"
questions.answer: Did you live in a village when you were a child?
questions.why: when you were a child adalah waktu yang sudah selesai, jadi past simple: Did you live ...?

questions.prompt: My father ___ (work) in Surabaya from 2005 to 2015. Now he works in Jakarta.
questions.why: Periode 2005 sampai 2015 sudah selesai, jadi past simple.

questions.source: Saya belum melihat Andi hari ini.
questions.answer: I have not seen Andi today
accept: I have not seen Andi yet today
questions.why: today belum selesai, jadi present perfect: haven't seen.
Periode sampai sekarang memakai present perfect; waktu yang sudah selesai memakai past simple.
in 2019 adalah waktu yang sudah selesai, jadi pakai past simple.
